QuestInfo.name: Eclipse and Sunfire
QuestInfo.0: #b#e#p1032209##k#n wants to teach you how to control light and darkness.
QuestInfo.1:
#bReach Light, Dark, and Equilibrium.#k

1. Using a Light spell grants the #bSunfire buff #v3800309# that fills your heart with light#k. Using a Dark spell grants the #bEclipse buff #v3800310# that fills your heart with darkness#k.
2. When you have the Sunfire buff, you restore 1% HP every time you use a Light spell and Light spells deal 50% more damage.
3. When you have the Eclipse buff, skills do not cost MP and using Dark spells deal 50% more damage.
4. Use Equilibrium Liberation to achieve #bEquilibrium #v3800311##k. When the Equilibrium ends, you'll return to whichever state you were in before entering Equilibrium.
5. This gives you both the Sunfire and Eclipse effects, as well as #r100% Knockback Resistance, no cooldowns, combination Light/Dark spells that deal 100% extra damage#k.

(Eye/Orb color changed during Equilibrium)
#v3800322#
